label: Puerto Rico · Nov 7–14
summary: El Yunque, new-moon bio bay, Culebra turtle snorkel, Guánica dry forest, karst cave; car, 3 bases, ~$2043 pp.
title: Puerto Rico: Rainforest, Bio Bay, Reef & Dry Forest
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Nov 7 → LAX **Sat Nov 14**. 7 nights in PR, 0 on planes. 1-stop flights both ways.
- **Route:** Old San Juan 1n → Río Grande/El Yunque 3n → La Parguera 2n → Old San Juan 1n. Car Nov 8–13.
- **Bio bay:** Laguna Grande kayak **Mon Nov 9** = new moon (02:03 AST). 2nd bay La Parguera Nov 12.
- **Snorkel:** **Tue Nov 10** catamaran day from Fajardo to Culebra reefs (Tamarindo/Culebrita: green turtles, rays, reef fish). Lunch + gear incl. DIY ferry option shown.
- **Nature:** El Yunque at 08:00 gate, coquí nights, Guánica dry forest at dawn (endemics), Cabo Rojo flats, Cueva Ventana.
- **Culture:** Old San Juan forts (NPS), Ponce lunch stop.
- **Pace:** max ~3h driving/day. No full rest day now (Culebra replaced it); Nov 12 afternoon kept loose. ~$2043 pp.

itinerary.title: Fly to Puerto Rico
itinerary.details: Early 1-stop (via MIA/CLT/DFW/ATL/JFK). LAX ~06:00–08:00 → SJU ~18:00–21:00 (+4h clock). Taxi 20m to Old San Juan. Street food, sleep.

itinerary.title: Forts, then east
itinerary.details: 08:30 El Morro + San Cristóbal (one ~$10 fee). Paseo del Morro walk. Lunch. Taxi to SJU, pick up car ~13:00. ~50m PR-26/PR-3 east. Dusk: coquí chorus at guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Rainforest + bio bay (new moon)
itinerary.details: Gate 08:00 (PR-191 free, no reservation; closes at capacity: go early, Monday quieter). El Portal center ($8). Short trails open (check alerts; La Mina closed). Parrot/tody/lizard-cuckoo watch. Nap. ~18:00 Laguna Grande kayak, ~2h. New moon 02:03 AST today: darkest night. Bed by 22:00: boat tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Culebra snorkel day (catamaran)
itinerary.details: 07:45 drive ~35m to Puerto del Rey marina, Fajardo. ~08:30–09:00 catamaran, ~45–50m crossing. Captain picks the calm spot: Tamarindo/Carlos Rosario (west side, Luis Peña reserve: turtles, reef) or Culebrita/Flamenco. 2 snorkel stops, beach time, buffet lunch, drinks, gear. Back ~15:00. Siesta. Easy dinner. Bio bay backup tonight only if Nov 9 rained out. Swell cancels? Fall back to Luquillo swim + kioskos.
itinerary.meals: B own; L on boat; D own

itinerary.title: Cross to the southwest
itinerary.details: ~1h50 PR-30/PR-52 (tolls) to Ponce. Lunch + Parque de Bombas, plaza, cathedral (~2h). ~1h on to La Parguera. Sunset on the water.

itinerary.title: Dry forest + endemic birds
itinerary.details: 06:30 Guánica dry forest (30m): nightjar zone, Adelaide's warbler, lizard-cuckoo, tody. Out before heat (~11:00). Optional 2nd snorkel: Gilligan's Island / Cayo Aurora, 10m boat from Restaurante San Jacinto (~$11; mangrove + seagrass, calm, shallow; no shade/food; confirm open). Siesta. Cabo Rojo salt flats only if fresh (skip = easier day). ~19:30 La Parguera bio bay boat (moon sets early; dark).

itinerary.location: La Parguera → Cueva Ventana → Old San Juan
itinerary.title: Karst cave, back to San Juan
itinerary.details: ~1h50 north (PR-2 or scenic PR-10 via karst). Cueva Ventana tour (~1h, $19). Optional Río Camuy only if confirmed open. ~1h PR-22 to SJU, return car. Taxi to Old San Juan. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Fly home

booking_timeline.task: Book LAX–SJU 1-stop RT, out Sat Nov 7 early, home Sat Nov 14 midday. Avoid basic economy if bags. Book Old San Juan (Nov 7, 13), Río Grande (Nov 8–10), La Parguera (Nov 11–12), free-cancel.
Ferry Ceiba–Culebra seats for Nov 10 open ~30 days out on puertoricoferry.com / app; sell out fast. Check the Nov PDF timetable. Book golf cart ahead.
Book compact car SJU Nov 8 → Nov 13. Ask in writing: AutoExpreso tag fee (flat vs per use). Check credit-card CDW covers PR.

Book Laguna Grande kayak Mon Nov 9 ~18:00 (2nd choice Tue Nov 10). Ask rain policy. Book Culebra catamaran Tue Nov 10 (East Island or similar, Puerto del Rey); ask swell policy + min-pax rule. If Vieques: book ferry + tour + room now.
Check El Yunque alerts (open trails, any new fee). Check Río Camuy status by phone/DRNA. Book La Parguera boat Nov 12. Optional bird guide. Confirm Gilligan's Island boat running (787-821-5706).
Check NHC tropical outlook. Download offline maps. Buy America the Beautiful pass only if using elsewhere ($80). Nov 8–9: check marine forecast (north swell).
Fly. Card for everything; small cash for kioskos/tips.

practical:
## Entry
- US citizens: domestic flight. No passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.

## Flights
- No nonstop LAX–SJU found. 1 stop: AA (MIA/CLT/DFW), Delta (ATL), JetBlue (JFK/BOS/MCO), Spirit/Frontier (MCO/FLL).
- Red-eyes exist (LAX ~22:00 → SJU ~noon next day) but cost a night. Plan: early Sat departure, arrive evening.
- PR = AST (UTC−4), no DST. LA = PST after Nov 1: **+4h** going east.

## Car? Yes.
- El Yunque at 08:00, Fajardo bio bay, southwest (Guánica, La Parguera, Cabo Rojo), Cueva Ventana: no transit. Uber thin outside metro.
- Tours-only = San Juan base, long pickups, no southwest. Costs more.
- No car in Old San Juan nights: narrow streets, scarce parking.
- **AutoExpreso**: all tolls electronic. Rental tag mandatory; fee flat/day or per use + tolls. Ask at pickup. Tolls up slightly Jan 2026.
- Distances in km, speed in mph, gas in liters. Driving assertive; potholes; avoid unlit mountain roads at night.

## Money
- USD. Cards widely; cash for kioskos, tips. NHS forts cashless.
- Tip 15–20%. Bio bay guides ~$10.

## Safety
- Generally fine for tourists. Usual car rules: nothing visible in car, esp. beach/trailheads.
- Bio bay: no sunscreen/repellent before kayak (harms organisms); follow guide. Life vest.
- Flash floods: stay out of rivers when raining upstream (El Yunque).

## Snorkel (Culebra Nov 10, Gilligan's Nov 12)
- Tour: lunch, drinks, mask/fins incl. Bring own mask if picky. Towel not incl.
- Tamarindo, Melones, Carlos Rosario = Canal Luis Peña reserve: no fishing, no touching/taking coral, no standing on reef. Keep ~3 m from turtles; no chasing.
- Reef-safe (mineral, zinc) sunscreen, or better: long-sleeve rash guard + hat. Apply 30m before.
- Nov = north swell season. North beaches (Flamenco, Carlos Rosario edge) can break; west/south (Tamarindo, Melones, Culebrita lee) calmer. Captain decides. Seasick-prone: pill before boarding.
- Water shoes: rocky, urchin entries at Tamarindo/Carlos Rosario.
- Water ~28°C: no wetsuit needed.

## Weather
- Highs ~29°C/84°F, lows ~22–24°C. Short showers, often afternoon. El Yunque wet any day.
- Hurricane season ends Nov 30: low but real risk. Watch NHC; free-cancel bookings.
- Rain/clouds dim bio bays. Bays close in storms.

## Packing
- Rain shell, quick-dry clothes, trail shoes with grip (slick), sandals, swimsuit, headlamp (red light for coquí), binoculars, repellent (mosquitoes + no-see-ums at dusk, esp. La Parguera/Fajardo), reef-safe sunscreen, dry bag.

## Food
- Mofongo, lechón, alcapurrias, bacalaítos. Kiosk lunch $10–15; dinner $25–40 pp. Tap water OK in metro; bottled in rural spots after storms.

fatigue_check:
Door-to-door travel per day:
- Nov 7 | 1-stop flight ~9h30 + 20m taxi | long-haul (daytime; sleep early)
- Nov 8 | 20m taxi + ~50m drive | light
- Nov 9 | 25m + 25m + 2h kayak at night | light road; late night
- Nov 10 | 35m drive + ~6h boat day (2× ~50m crossings) + 35m | medium; seated boat, lunch served, back ~15:30, siesta
- Nov 11 | ~1h50 + ~1h, split by Ponce lunch | medium (~2h50)
- Nov 12 | ~30m ×2 (+ optional Gilligan's 10m boat) | light; dawn start, siesta; Cabo Rojo optional
- Nov 13 | ~1h50 + ~1h + 20m taxi, split by cave | medium (~3h)
- Nov 14 | 20m + ~10h flight | long-haul home, same day

Rules:
- **Max ~3h driving/day:** met. Nov 10 only ~1h10 driving.
- **No back-to-back medium days:** BROKEN once (Nov 10 boat → Nov 11 drive). Mitigated: Nov 10 ends ~15:30, early night; Nov 11 start 09:30, Ponce break mid-drive.
- **Slow day mid-trip:** LOST (Culebra replaced it). Nov 12 afternoon is the soft spot: siesta, skip Cabo Rojo if tired. Want the rest day back: keep-luquillo-slow option.
- **Swim stops:** Culebra Nov 10; optional Gilligan's Nov 12.
- 3 bases (+ San Juan bookends): no 1-night stops except San Juan arrival/departure.
- Late nights: bio bay Nov 9 (then 07:45 start Nov 10: 9h sleep possible if in bed 22:00), Nov 12 optional.
